## CHR
```{r}
us_soc <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "national",
  measure = 140,
  release_year = 2025
) |> subset(select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high)
            )
us_soc$fips <- paste(us_soc$state_fips,us_soc$county_fips)

ne_soc <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "state",
  measure = 140,
  release_year = 2025,
) |> filter(state_fips %in%  c("25", "09", "23", "33", "50", "44")
            )|> subset(select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

county_soc <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "county",
  measure = 140,
  release_year = 2025
) |> filter(state_fips == "25") |> subset(
  select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

ne_soc$fips <- paste(ne_soc$state_fips,ne_soc$county_fips)
county_soc$fips <- paste(county_soc$state_fips,county_soc$county_fips)

scalar_soc <- bind_rows(county_soc, ne_soc, us_soc)

```

#Voter Turnout
```{r}

us_vot <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "national",
  measure = 177,
  release_year = 2024
) |> subset(select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high)
            )
us_vot$fips <- paste(us_vot$state_fips,us_vot$county_fips)

ne_vot <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "state",
  measure = 177,
  release_year = 2024
) |> filter(state_fips %in%  c("25", "09", "23", "33", "50", "44")
            )|> subset(select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

county_vot <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "county",
  measure = 177,
  release_year = 2024
) |> filter(state_fips == "25") |> subset(
  select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

ne_vot$fips <- paste(ne_vot$state_fips,ne_vot$county_fips)
county_vot$fips <- paste(county_vot$state_fips,county_vot$county_fips)

scalar_vot <- bind_rows(county_vot, ne_vot, us_vot)

```
